name: Tiny Farm HQ (this app)
summary: The CEO's operating surface: org chart with personas, chief-of-staff chat routed to any team member, the living entity gallery, the program report, and the decision inbox that mirrors the designer queue. Runs locally and starts at boot.
requirements: Runs on localhost with zero external dependencies
Starts automatically at boot (systemd user service)
Org chart with every persona browsable and chattable
Entity gallery with animated sprites and asset/code/sound references
Program report with per-project pages (requirements, status, plan)
Decision inbox parsed live from the designer queue doc
current_status: Shipped 2026-09-01, then rebuilt the same day into the command center: derived pillar signals (git/CI/traces/tags — nothing hand-maintained), the Eye of Sauron queue, pillar pages with living demos, the playtest viewer, the in-app verification runner, and the chief-of-staff brief. Next natural increments: a KPI page once there is revenue, and richer per-persona demo automation.
